entries.name: homer
entries.productSummary: Homer is a static homepage for self-hosted services: a YAML-configured dashboard of service tiles with search and theming.

entries.name: conduit
entries.productSummary: Conduit is a Medium-style social blogging platform: write, favorite, and comment on articles and follow authors.

entries.name: midday
entries.productSummary: Midday is an all-in-one financial management platform for freelancers and small businesses: track transactions, send invoices, and see business health at a glance.

entries.name: vite-spa
entries.productSummary: Fieldnote is a quick notes app for people who work outside: add notes, search them, and pin the important ones.

entries.name: pnpm-monorepo
entries.productSummary: Crewboard is a task board for small crews: add tasks with optional assignees and move them from To do through Done.

entries.name: npm-express-static
entries.productSummary: Trailhead helps plan a day hike: convert distances between miles and kilometers and keep a packing checklist.
